This is an application seeking to quash the First Information Report bearing Crime No.620 of 2023 registered with the Pusad City Police Station District Yavatmal for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 463, 468 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections, 7, 12, 19, 21 of the Chemical Fertilizer (Control) Order, 1985 and 19(C)(2), 19(C)(5) of the Chemical Fertilizer Control Rules as well as 3(2)(d) of the Essential Commodities Act, 1955.

sentences.text: 3. On secret information, the Agricultural Officer has raided the residence of the applicant with Panch Witnesses and found several fertilizers stored at residence without authorization.
4. It is alleged that the goods seized are suspicious and misbranded.
The Authorities took samples for verification.
5. Learned Counsel for the applicant would submit that due to heavy rainfall, he shifted the goods from 2 909.apl.71.2024 godwon to his residence for time being purely for safety and not for sale.

This is an application seeking to quash the First Information Report bearing Crime No.620 of 2023 registered with the Pusad City Police Station District Yavatmal for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 463, 468 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections, 7, 12, 19, 21 of the Chemical Fertilizer (Control) Order, 1985 and 19(C)(2), 19(C)(5) of the Chemical Fertilizer Control Rules as well as 3(2)(d) of the Essential Commodities Act, 1955.
3. On secret information, the Agricultural Officer has raided the residence of the applicant with Panch Witnesses and found several fertilizers stored at residence without authorization.
4. It is alleged that the goods seized are suspicious and misbranded.
